items.headline: Major Brands Unite to Combat Microfiber Pollution in Manufacturing

items.headline: China Implements Fish Embryo Testing for Textile Wastewater

items.headline: EU Commission Releases Textile Strategy Focused on Innovation and Local Production
items.blurb: Designers and buyers should track new European sourcing standards that could reshape supply chain decisions and production timelines.

items.blurb: Multiple fiber options enable designers to customize hand-feel and appearance without changing base materials.
